candidates.name: Precita Eyes Muralists Association
candidates.note: Registers and documents community murals in the area; maintains artist attribution records and can identify unsigned works.

candidates.name: Building owner of record (county assessor parcel lookup)
candidates.note: The wall's owner often commissioned the mural or holds the artist agreement; assessor records identify who to ask.

candidates.name: Local street-art documentation project (Mural Registry / street-art map)
candidates.note: Geotagged mural databases frequently attribute works that carry no visible signature.
